rows.sql: SELECT birth_continent, CASE WHEN death_country != '' AND death_country != birth_country THEN 'died_abroad' WHEN death_country != '' THEN 'died_in_birth_country' ELSE 'death_country_unknown' END AS death_place, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' GROUP BY birth_continent, death_place
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE awards >= 2 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN death_country != '' AND death_country != birth_country THEN 'died_abroad' WHEN death_country != '' THEN 'died_in_birth_country' ELSE 'death_country_unknown' END AS death_place, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count FROM art WHERE age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY death_place

SELECT CASE WHEN awards = 0 THEN 'no_awards' WHEN awards = 1 THEN 'one_award' ELSE 'multiple_awards' END AS award_band, teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE teaching IS NOT NULL AND awards IS NOT NULL GROUP BY award_band, teaching
SELECT birth_country, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_country != '' GROUP BY birth_country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN age < 60 THEN 'under_60' ELSE '60_or_older' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family, age_band
SELECT teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE teaching IS NOT NULL AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY teaching
SELECT style, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE style != '' GROUP BY style HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15

SELECT century, CASE WHEN age < 50 THEN 'under_50' WHEN age < 75 THEN '50_to_74' ELSE '75_or_older' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE century != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY century, age_band

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_count FROM art WHERE field != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN color IN ('Earth Tones', 'Blue', 'Green', 'Red', 'Black And White', 'Brown', 'Yellow') THEN color WHEN color != '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE color != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY color_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE century IN ('20th', '20th-21st') AND field != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field != '' GROUP BY field_family, award_status
SELECT style, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE style != '' GROUP BY style HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15

SELECT CASE WHEN birth_continent IN ('Europe', 'North America') THEN birth_continent ELSE 'Other' END AS continent_group, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' GROUP BY continent_group, award_status

SELECT century, CASE WHEN nationality = 'American' THEN 'American' WHEN nationality != '' THEN 'non_American' END AS nationality_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE century != '' AND nationality != '' GROUP BY century, nationality_group
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE teaching = 1 AND century != '' GROUP BY century

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN color IN ('Earth Tones', 'Blue', 'Green', 'Red', 'Black And White', 'Brown', 'Yellow') THEN color WHEN color != '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field != '' AND color != '' GROUP BY field_family, color_family

SELECT style, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE style IN ('Expressionism', 'Romanticism', 'Impressionism', 'Realism', 'Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism') AND century != '' GROUP BY style, century
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE century != '' GROUP BY century
SELECT birth_continent, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY birth_continent

SELECT image_genre, CASE WHEN color IN ('Earth Tones', 'Blue', 'Green', 'Red') THEN color ELSE 'Other' END AS color_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract') AND color != '' GROUP BY image_genre, color_group
SELECT CASE WHEN art_institution != '' THEN 'known_institution' ELSE 'institution_unknown' END AS institution_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art GROUP BY institution_status
SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE awards >= 1 AND birth_continent != '' GROUP BY birth_continent

SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN death_country != '' AND death_country != birth_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS died_abroad_count, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition LIKE '%Asymmetrical%' AND century != '' GROUP BY century

SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, SUM(awards) AS total_awards FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
SELECT style, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE tone IN ('Bright', 'Dark') AND style != '' GROUP BY style HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field != '' AND century != '' GROUP BY field_family, century

SELECT birth_country, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_country IN ('United States', 'France', 'United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Italy') AND century != '' GROUP BY birth_country, century

SELECT image_genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, MIN(age) AS youngest, MAX(age) AS oldest, SUM(awards) AS total_awards FROM art WHERE image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract', 'Sculpture') AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY image_genre
SELECT birth_continent, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM art WHERE awards >= 1 AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 AND birth_continent != '' GROUP BY birth_continent
SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' GROUP BY birth_continent

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE field != '' AND century != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY field_family, century HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone != '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE tone != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY tone_family

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone != '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, image_genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE tone != '' AND image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract') GROUP BY tone_family, image_genre

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field != '' GROUP BY field_family

SELECT image_genre, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Still Life', 'Abstract', 'Sculpture', 'Figurative') GROUP BY image_genre, award_status
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT style, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE style IN ('Expressionism', 'Romanticism', 'Impressionism', 'Realism', 'Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism') AND teaching IS NOT NULL GROUP BY style, teaching_status
SELECT teaching, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE age >= 80 AND age <= 105 AND teaching IS NOT NULL GROUP BY teaching
SELECT century, MIN(age) AS youngest FROM art WHERE century != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY century

SELECT CASE WHEN color IN ('Earth Tones', 'Blue', 'Green', 'Red', 'Black And White', 'Brown', 'Yellow') THEN color WHEN color != '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE color != '' GROUP BY color_family

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone != '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre = 'Portrait' AND color IN ('Earth Tones', 'Blue', 'Red', 'Black And White') GROUP BY tone_family
SELECT century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, MIN(age) AS youngest, MAX(age) AS oldest, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE century != '' AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY century

SELECT birth_continent, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE birth_continent != '' AND teaching IS NOT NULL GROUP BY birth_continent, teaching_status

SELECT style, CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark') THEN tone ELSE 'Other' END AS tone_group, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE style IN ('Expressionism', 'Romanticism', 'Impressionism', 'Realism', 'Surrealism') AND tone != '' GROUP BY style, tone_group

SELECT CASE WHEN death_city LIKE '%paris%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN death_city LIKE '%york%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN death_city LIKE '%london%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' GROUP BY field_family, award_status
SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE art_movement <> '' GROUP BY art_movement
SELECT CASE WHEN object <> '' THEN 'known_institution' ELSE 'institution_unknown' END AS institution_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art GROUP BY institution_status

SELECT marriage, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE marriage <> '' AND NOT teaching IS NULL GROUP BY marriage, teaching_status

SELECT composition, CASE WHEN teaching = 1 THEN 'taught' ELSE 'did_not_teach' END AS teaching_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic', 'Symmetrical', 'Central Focus') AND NOT teaching IS NULL GROUP BY composition, teaching_status

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE object IN ('Geometric Shapes', 'Human Figure') AND field <> '' GROUP BY field_family
SELECT genre, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE genre <> '' GROUP BY genre

SELECT CASE WHEN field LIKE '%Painting%' THEN 'Painting' WHEN field LIKE '%Sculpture%' THEN 'Sculpture' WHEN field LIKE '%Photography%' THEN 'Photography' ELSE 'Other' END AS field_family, CASE WHEN zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini', 'Leo', 'Aquarius', 'Sagittarius') THEN zodiac WHEN zodiac <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS color_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE field <> '' AND zodiac <> '' GROUP BY field_family, color_family
SELECT zodiac, century, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE zodiac IN ('Aries', 'Taurus', 'Pisces', 'Gemini', 'Leo') AND century <> '' GROUP BY zodiac, century
SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition <> '' GROUP BY composition
SELECT composition, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE teaching = 1 AND awards = 0 AND composition <> '' GROUP BY composition HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT composition, CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 'awarded' ELSE 'unawarded' END AS award_status, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE composition IN ('Balanced', 'Asymmetrical', 'Centralized', 'Dynamic', 'Symmetrical', 'Central Focus') GROUP BY composition, award_status
SELECT marriage, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE marriage <> '' GROUP BY marriage HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(awards) AS max_awards FROM art WHERE genre IN ('Abstract', 'Landscape', 'Portrait', 'Figurative', 'Portrait||Landscape', 'Landscape||Portrait', 'Surrealism', 'Avant-garde') AND age BETWEEN 25 AND 105 GROUP BY genre

SELECT CASE WHEN tone IN ('Neutral', 'Bright', 'Dark', 'Warm') THEN tone WHEN tone <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS tone_family, COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM art WHERE image_genre = 'Portrait' AND object IN ('Geometric Shapes', 'Human Figure', 'Human Figures', 'Shapes') GROUP BY tone_family
SELECT death_city, AVG(awards) AS avg_awards FROM art WHERE death_city <> '' GROUP BY death_city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
